**Underwriting Analysis**

**DTI**: 28.53% (housing $2,568 ÷ income $9,000) — well within DU limits.  
**LTV**: 70% ($318,500 ÷ $455,000) — ≤80%, so no minimum borrower contribution required for 2–4 unit principal residence (B3-4.3-06).  
**Funds to close**: $147,852 (down payment $136,500 + closing costs $11,352).  
**Available funds**: $141,760 (bank) + $82,000 (gift) = $223,760 — sufficient.  
**Reserves**: 29.56 months post-closing — exceeds 6-month requirement for 2–4 unit principal residence (B3-4.1-01).  
**Credit**: 765 score, no bankruptcy/foreclosure — no waiting-period concerns.  
**Gift**: $82,000 from parent (acceptable donor per B3-4.3-04). Gift letter indicated but contents not verified; donor fund availability and transfer not yet documented (B3-4.3-04).

**Conditions needed**:  
1. Complete gift letter with all required elements: gift amount, donor statement of no repayment, donor name/address/phone/relationship (B3-4.3-04).  
2. Verification of donor funds and transfer (donor check/deposit slip, electronic transfer evidence, or settlement statement showing receipt) (B3-4.3-04).

DECISION: approve with conditions  
RULES: B3-4.3-04
